## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `Fetch` trait | Async trait for single-object retrieval with proof verification. `T::fetch(&sdk, query).await?` returns `Option<T>`. Also provides `fetch_with_metadata()`, `fetch_with_metadata_and_proof()`, `fetch_with_settings()`, and `fetch_by_identifier()`. Implemented for Identity, DataContract, Document, Vote, ExtendedEpochInfo, IdentityBalance, IdentityBalanceAndRevision, IdentityNonceFetcher, IdentityContractNonceFetcher, DataContractHistory, PrefundedSpecializedBalance, IdentitiesContractKeys, TokenContractInfo, RewardDistributionMoment, AddressInfo, TotalCreditsInPlatform, RecentAddressBalanceChanges, RecentCompactedAddressBalanceChanges, PlatformAddressTrunkState. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch.rs] |
| `FetchMany` trait | Async trait for batch retrieval with proofs. `T::fetch_many(&sdk, query).await?` returns a keyed collection `O: FromIterator<(K, Option<Self>)>`. Convenience methods: `fetch_by_identifiers()`, `fetch_many_with_limit()`, `fetch_many_with_metadata()`, `fetch_many_with_metadata_and_proof()`. Implemented for Document/Documents, DataContract/DataContracts, IdentityPublicKey/IdentityPublicKeys, ExtendedEpochInfo/ExtendedEpochInfos, FinalizedEpochInfo/FinalizedEpochInfos, ProtocolVersionVoteCount, MasternodeProtocolVote, ProposerBlockCountByRange, ProposerBlockCountById, ContestedResource, ContenderWithSerializedDocument, Voter, ResourceVote, VotePoll, IdentityBalance/IdentityBalances, AddressInfo/AddressInfos, Element/Elements, TokenPricingSchedule. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch_many.rs] |
| `FetchUnproved` trait | Fetches data without cryptographic proof verification. Used for endpoints like `EvoNodeStatus` (node status) and `CurrentQuorumsInfo` where proofs are not available. Provides `fetch_unproved()` and `fetch_unproved_with_settings()`. Uses `FromUnproved` trait instead of `FromProof`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch_unproved.rs] |
| `FetchCurrent` trait | Parameter-free fetch for singleton platform state (e.g., current epoch, total credits). `T::fetch_current(&sdk).await?` with no query argument needed. Also provides `fetch_current_with_metadata()` and `fetch_current_with_metadata_and_proof()`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch_current_no_parameters.rs] |
| `Query` trait | Converts domain objects into gRPC `TransportRequest` messages. `fn query(self, prove: bool) -> Result<T, Error>`. Blanket impl allows any `TransportRequest` to be its own Query. Implemented by `Identifier` (for contracts, identities, keys, prefunded balances), `DocumentQuery`, `DriveDocumentQuery`, `VotePollsByDocumentTypeQuery`, `ContestedDocumentVotePollDriveQuery`, `ContestedDocumentVotePollVotesDriveQuery`, `ContestedResourceVotesGivenByIdentityQuery`, `VotePollsByEndDateDriveQuery`, `EpochIndex`, `EvoNode`, `PlatformAddress`, `BTreeSet<PlatformAddress>`, `ProTxHash`, `VoteQuery`, `KeysInPath`, `NoParamQuery`, `IdentityKeysQuery`, `TokenLastClaimQuery`, `ProposerBlockCountByIdsQuery`, `RecentAddressBalanceChangesQuery`, `RecentCompactedAddressBalanceChangesQuery`, `&[Identifier]` (for token prices). | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/query.rs] |
| `LimitQuery<Q>` wrapper | Generic pagination wrapper with fields: `query: Q`, `limit: Option<u32>`, `start_info: Option<QueryStartInfo>`. `QueryStartInfo` has `start_key: Vec<u8>` and `start_included: bool`. Implements `From<Q>` for ergonomic conversion. Used with `FetchMany::fetch_many_with_limit()` or constructed directly. Implements `Query` for epochs, protocol votes, contested resources, vote state, voters, proposed blocks, and vote query types. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/query.rs] |
| `DocumentQuery` builder | Rich query builder for document fetches. Fields: `data_contract`, `document_type_name`, `where_clauses`, `order_by_clauses`, `limit`, `start`. Constructors: `new(contract, type_name)`, `new_with_data_contract_id(sdk, id, type_name)` (auto-fetches contract), `new_with_drive_query()`. Fluent methods: `with_document_id(&id)`, `with_where(clause)`, `with_order_by(clause)`. Converts to/from `DriveDocumentQuery` and `GetDocumentsRequest`. Where clauses use `WhereClause { field, operator: WhereOperator, value }`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/documents/document_query.rs] |
| `BroadcastStateTransition` | Core trait for submitting state transitions to Platform. Three methods: `broadcast()` (fire-and-forget), `wait_for_response::<T>()` (proof-verified typed result with timeout support), `broadcast_and_wait::<T>()` (combined). Verifies proofs via `Drive::verify_state_transition_was_executed_with_proof()`. Auto-refreshes identity nonce on broadcast failure. Retry with node failover via `retry()`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/broadcast.rs] |
| `Put*` traits | Family of async traits for full state transition lifecycle: `PutIdentity` (asset lock or address funding), `PutContract`, `PutDocument`, `PutVote`, `TopUpIdentity`, `TransferToIdentity`, `WithdrawFromIdentity`. Each acquires nonces, constructs transitions, validates structure via `ensure_valid_state_transition_structure()`, signs, broadcasts, and returns proof-verified results. Provides both `put_to_platform()` (returns StateTransition) and `put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response()` (returns typed result). | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/] |
| `Waitable` trait | Convenience trait wrapping `BroadcastStateTransition::wait_for_response()` for typed results. Implementations: DataContract (direct), Document (extracts single doc from batch by ID), Identity (handles `AlreadyExists` by falling back to fetch), Vote (direct). | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/waitable.rs] |
| Token builder pattern | Struct-based builders for token operations: `TokenMintTransitionBuilder`, `TokenTransferTransitionBuilder`, `TokenBurnTransitionBuilder`, `TokenFreezeTransitionBuilder`, `TokenUnfreezeTransitionBuilder`, `TokenClaimTransitionBuilder`, `TokenSetPriceTransitionBuilder`, `TokenPurchaseTransitionBuilder`, `TokenDestroyTransitionBuilder`, `TokenConfigUpdateTransitionBuilder`, `TokenEmergencyActionTransitionBuilder`. Fluent API: `::new(contract, pos, id, amount).with_public_note(n).with_using_group_info(g)`. Broadcast via `sdk.token_mint(builder, &key, &signer)`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/tokens/builders/] |
| Document transition builders | Struct-based builders: `DocumentCreateTransitionBuilder`, `DocumentReplaceTransitionBuilder`, `DocumentDeleteTransitionBuilder`, `DocumentTransferTransitionBuilder`, `DocumentPurchaseTransitionBuilder`, `DocumentSetPriceTransitionBuilder`. Common fluent methods: `.with_token_payment_info()`, `.with_state_transition_creation_options()`, `.with_user_fee_increase()`, `.with_settings()`. Broadcast via `sdk.document_create(builder, &key, &signer)` etc. Builder `.sign()` method acquires nonce and returns `StateTransition`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/documents/transitions/] |
| `PutSettings` configuration | Struct configuring broadcast behavior: `request_settings: RequestSettings`, `identity_nonce_stale_time_s: Option<u64>`, `user_fee_increase: Option<UserFeeIncrease>`, `wait_timeout: Option<Duration>`, `state_transition_creation_options: Option<StateTransitionCreationOptions>`. Passed as `Option<PutSettings>` to all Put/broadcast methods. Implements `Default` and `From<PutSettings> for RequestSettings`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/put_settings.rs] |
| Automatic proof verification | Every `Fetch`/`FetchMany` call verifies GroveDB proofs via `FromProof` trait and `parse_proof_with_metadata_and_proof()`. State transition results verified via `Drive::verify_state_transition_was_executed_with_proof()`. `fetch_with_metadata_and_proof()` exposes raw proof for educational/debugging purposes. Core security property of the Rust SDK. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch.rs] |
| `delegate_enum!` macro | Macro for supporting multiple request/response types for a single object (e.g., Identity can be fetched by ID or by public key hash). Creates wrapper enums and delegates `TransportRequest` and `FromProof` to the appropriate variant. Used in `types/identity.rs` for `IdentityRequest`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/delegate.rs] |
| Mock SDK testing | `Sdk::new_mock()` creates a mock SDK for deterministic testing. Register expectations: `sdk.mock().expect_fetch(query, Some(expected)).await`. Supports identity, data contract, document mocks. Chain expectations (e.g., mock contract before document query that auto-fetches contract). Duplicate expectations for same query return error. `MockResponse` trait marks mockable types. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Nonce management | SDK manages identity nonces and identity-contract nonces. `sdk.get_identity_nonce(owner_id, bump, settings)` and `sdk.get_identity_contract_nonce(owner_id, contract_id, bump, settings)` fetch from Platform with local caching. Nonces auto-refresh on broadcast failure via `sdk.refresh_identity_nonce()`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/put_contract.rs] |
| Retry with node failover | All fetch and broadcast operations use `retry(sdk.address_list(), settings, closure)` for automatic retry and node failover. The closure receives `RequestSettings` and returns `ExecutionResponse { inner, address, retries }`. `IntoInner` extracts the result. Settings merged via `sdk.dapi_client_settings.override_by(settings)`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/fetch.rs] |
| `SdkBuilder` setup | `SdkBuilder::new(address_list).with_network(Network::Testnet).with_context_provider(provider).build()`. Requires a `ContextProvider` for contract caching and quorum key lookups. Common providers: `GrpcContextProvider` (RPC-based, needs Core credentials) and `TrustedHttpContextProvider` (HTTP-based, simpler setup). Context provider can be set after build via `sdk.set_context_provider()`. | [P:rs-sdk/examples/read_contract.rs] |
| DPNS high-level API | Methods directly on `Sdk`: `sdk.get_dpns_usernames_by_identity()`, `sdk.resolve_dpns_name()`, `sdk.is_dpns_name_available()`, `sdk.search_dpns_names()`, `sdk.get_contested_non_resolved_usernames()`, `sdk.get_non_resolved_dpns_contests_for_identity()`. Wraps DocumentQuery + FetchMany internally. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/dpns_usernames/queries.rs] |
| Group actions queries | `GroupQuery`, `GroupInfosQuery`, `GroupActionsQuery { contract_id, group_contract_position, status, start_at_action_id, limit }`, `GroupActionSignersQuery` structs implement Query for fetching data contract groups, their actions, and signers. `GroupAction::fetch_many(&sdk, query)` returns active/closed group actions. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/group_actions.rs] |
| Token balance/info queries | `IdentityTokenBalancesQuery` (one identity, many tokens) and `IdentitiesTokenBalancesQuery` (many identities, one token) for balance fetching. `IdentityTokenInfosQuery`/`IdentitiesTokenInfosQuery` for freeze status. `TokenTotalSupplyQuery`/`TokensTotalSupplyQuery` for supply. `TokenStatusQuery` for pause state. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/tokens/] |
| Contested resource voting | Full lifecycle: create `ContestedDocumentResourceVotePoll { index_name, index_values, document_type_name, contract_id }`, wrap in `ResourceVoteV0 { vote_poll, resource_vote_choice }`, submit via `Vote::put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response()`. Query contenders with `ContestedDocumentVotePollDriveQuery`, voters with `ContestedDocumentVotePollVotesDriveQuery`, polls by end date with `VotePollsByEndDateDriveQuery`, identity votes with `ContestedResourceVotesGivenByIdentityQuery`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/vote.rs] |
| Address funding for identity | `Identity::put_with_address_funding()` creates identities funded by Platform addresses. Takes `inputs: BTreeMap<PlatformAddress, (AddressNonce, Credits)>`, optional output, identity signer, address signer. Uses `IdentityCreateFromAddressesTransition`. Returns `(Identity, AddressInfos)` with proof-verified address state. Identity ID deterministically derived from input addresses via `identity_id_from_input_addresses()`. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/put_identity.rs] |
| Identity-specific Query types | `IdentityKeysQuery::new(identity_id, key_ids).with_limit(n).with_offset(o)` for fetching specific keys. `VoteQuery::new(identity_id, vote_poll_id)` for single vote lookup. `TokenLastClaimQuery { token_id, identity_id }` for perpetual distribution claims. `ProposerBlockCountByIdsQuery { epoch, pro_tx_hashes }` for evonode block counts. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/query.rs] |
| `StateTransitionProofResult` dispatch | After `broadcast_and_wait::<StateTransitionProofResult>()`, match on variants: `VerifiedIdentityFullWithAddressInfos`, `VerifiedPartialIdentity`, `VerifiedDocuments`, etc. Each variant carries the proof-verified objects. `T::try_from(result)` converts to expected type. | [P:rs-sdk/src/platform/transition/broadcast.rs] |

## Examples
| Keyword | Description | File |
|---------|-------------|------|
| `read_contract` | Connects to Platform, builds SDK with `GrpcContextProvider` (Core RPC credentials, cache sizes), creates `AddressList` from URI, fetches `DataContract::fetch(&sdk, id)`. Shows full `SdkBuilder` setup flow with `context_provider.set_sdk()` for circular dependency. | [P:rs-sdk/examples/read_contract.rs] |
| `contested_names_with_contenders` | Uses `TrustedHttpContextProvider` for testnet (simpler setup, no Core RPC needed), calls `sdk.get_contested_non_resolved_usernames(Some(10))` to list unresolved DPNS name contests with contenders, vote tallies, and end times. | [P:rs-sdk/examples/contested_names_with_contenders.rs] |
| `identity_contested_names` | Queries contested DPNS names for a specific identity via `sdk.get_non_resolved_dpns_contests_for_identity(identity_id, Some(20))`. Shows `Identifier::from_string(str, Encoding::Base58)` parsing and contest result inspection with contender iteration. | [P:rs-sdk/examples/identity_contested_names.rs] |
| Mock fetch identity | `Sdk::new_mock()`, `sdk.mock().expect_fetch(query, Some(identity))`, then `Identity::fetch(&sdk, query)` returns expected object. Minimal test setup pattern. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Mock fetch data contract | Creates mock document type and data contract, registers with `sdk.mock().expect_fetch(id, Some(contract))`, verifies `DataContract::fetch(&sdk, id)` round-trips correctly. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Mock fetch document | Chains mock expectations: first for DataContract (needed by `DocumentQuery::new_with_data_contract_id()`), then for Document with `with_document_id()`. Uses `document_type.random_document()` for test data. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Mock fetch not found | Demonstrates `None` return: `sdk.mock().expect_fetch(id, None as Option<Identity>)` then asserts `Identity::fetch(&sdk, id)` returns `Ok(None)`. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Mock duplicate expectation | Second `expect_fetch()` for same query returns error. First expectation remains valid. Tests mock safety. | [P:rs-sdk/tests/fetch/mock_fetch.rs] |
| Register identity (asset lock) | Full flow: create asset lock tx, broadcast to Core, `wait_for_asset_lock_proof()`, build `Identity::new_with_id_and_keys()`, call `identity.put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response(sdk, asset_lock_proof, &private_key, &signer, None)`. Handles instant lock expiration by falling back to `ChainAssetLockProof`. Checks `Identity::fetch_by_identifier()` for existing identity first. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/register_identity.rs] |
| Register identity (platform addresses) | Fetches fresh nonces with `AddressInfo::fetch_many(&sdk, addresses)`, builds `inputs_with_nonces` map with `nonce + 1`, creates `Identity::new_with_input_addresses_and_keys(&inputs, keys, version)`, calls `identity.put_with_address_funding(&sdk, inputs, None, &identity_signer, &wallet_signer, None)`. Returns `(Identity, AddressInfos)`. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/register_identity.rs] |
| Load identity by ID | Parses ID from Base58/Hex via `Identifier::from_string()`, calls `Identity::fetch_by_identifier(sdk, id)`. Matches wallet keys to identity via derivation path scanning. Fetches DPNS names via `DocumentQuery` with `records.identity` where clause and `Document::fetch_many()`. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/load_identity.rs] |
| Register DPNS name | Two-step: (1) create preorder `Document::V0` with `saltedDomainHash`, call `put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response()` with entropy; (2) create domain `Document::V0` with label/records/subdomainRules properties, same broadcast. Re-fetches owned names via `Document::fetch_many()` with `records.identity` filter. Uses `convert_to_homograph_safe_chars()` for normalized labels. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/register_dpns_name.rs] |
| Top up identity | `identity.top_up_identity(&sdk, asset_lock_proof, &private_key, None, None)` returns updated balance as `u64`. Handles instant lock expiration with chain lock fallback. Calculates actual fee as `expected_credits - (new_balance - old_balance)`. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/top_up_identity.rs] |
| Withdraw from identity | Refreshes identity with `Identity::fetch_by_identifier()` first (gets latest revision/balance), then `identity.withdraw(&sdk, to_address, credits, Some(1), signing_key, signer, None)`. Returns remaining balance. Calculates fee as `old_balance - remaining - withdrawn`. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/withdraw_from_identity.rs] |
| Transfer credits | `identity.transfer_credits(&sdk, to_id, amount, signing_key, signer, None)` returns `(sender_balance, receiver_balance)`. Updates both local identities if receiver is known. Fee = `old_balance - sender_balance - amount`. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/transfer.rs] |
| Fetch contracts batch | `DataContract::fetch_many(sdk, identifiers)` returns `DataContracts` (map of `Identifier -> Option<DataContract>`). Iterates results, stores each in local DB. | [T:src/backend_task/contract.rs] |
| Fetch contract with description | Fetches contract, then queries search contract for description: `DocumentQuery { data_contract: search_contract, document_type_name: "fullDescription", where_clauses: [contractId == id] }`, `Document::fetch(sdk, query)`. Extracts description text from document properties. | [T:src/backend_task/contract.rs] |
| Register data contract | `data_contract.put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response(sdk, signing_key, &identity, None)` returns confirmed `DataContract`. On `DriveProofError`, attempts to extract contract ID from error and `DataContract::fetch()` as recovery. | [T:src/backend_task/register_contract.rs] |
| Fetch group actions | Iterates contract groups where identity is member (`group.members().contains_key(&id)`), queries each with `GroupActionsQuery { contract_id, group_contract_position, status: ActionActive, .. }` via `GroupAction::fetch_many(sdk, query)`. | [T:src/backend_task/contract.rs] |
| Fetch documents (paginated) | Sets `document_query.limit = 100`, calls `Document::fetch_many(sdk, query)`. Determines next page by checking `batch_len == 100`, sets `start: Some(Start::StartAfter(last_id.to_buffer().to_vec()))` for cursor. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document create (builder API) | `DocumentCreateTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, document, entropy).with_token_payment_info(payment).with_state_transition_creation_options(options)` then `sdk.document_create(builder, &key, &signer)`. Result: `DocumentCreateResult::Document(doc)`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document delete (builder API) | `DocumentDeleteTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, doc_id, owner_id)` then `sdk.document_delete(builder, &key, &signer)`. Result: `DocumentDeleteResult::Deleted(id)`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document replace (builder API) | `DocumentReplaceTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, document)` then `sdk.document_replace(builder, &key, &signer)`. Result: `DocumentReplaceResult::Document(doc)`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document transfer (builder API) | Fetch document first with `Document::fetch(sdk, query_with_id)`, call `document.bump_revision()`, build with `DocumentTransferTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, document, new_owner_id)`, then `sdk.document_transfer()`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document purchase (builder API) | Fetch document, bump revision, `DocumentPurchaseTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, document, buyer_id, price)`, then `sdk.document_purchase()`. Result: `DocumentPurchaseResult::Document(doc)`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Document set price (builder API) | Fetch document, bump revision, `DocumentSetPriceTransitionBuilder::new(contract, type_name, document, price)`, then `sdk.document_set_price()`. Result: `DocumentSetPriceResult::Document(doc)`. | [T:src/backend_task/document.rs] |
| Mint tokens | `TokenMintTransitionBuilder::new(contract, pos, issuer_id, amount).issued_to_identity_id(recipient).with_public_note(note).with_using_group_info(group)` then `sdk.token_mint(builder, &key, &signer)`. Handles `MintResult::TokenBalance`, `MintResult::HistoricalDocument`, `MintResult::GroupActionWithDocument`, `MintResult::GroupActionWithBalance`. | [T:src/backend_task/tokens/mint_tokens.rs] |
| Transfer tokens | `TokenTransferTransitionBuilder::new(contract, pos, sender_id, recipient_id, amount).with_public_note(note)` then `sdk.token_transfer(builder, &key, &signer)`. Handles `TransferResult::IdentitiesBalances` (map), `TransferResult::HistoricalDocument`, `TransferResult::GroupActionWithDocument`. | [T:src/backend_task/tokens/transfer_tokens.rs] |
| Vote on DPNS name | Creates `ContestedDocumentResourceVotePoll { index_name, index_values: ["dash", name], document_type_name: "domain", contract_id }`, wraps in `ResourceVoteV0`, calls `vote.put_to_platform_and_wait_for_response(pro_tx_hash, &voting_key, sdk, &signer, None)`. Iterates multiple voter identities. | [T:src/backend_task/contested_names/vote_on_dpns_name.rs] |
| Query vote contenders | Builds `ContestedDocumentVotePollDriveQuery { vote_poll, allow_include_locked_and_abstaining_vote_tally: true, result_type: DocumentsAndVoteTally }`, calls `ContenderWithSerializedDocument::fetch_many(sdk, query)`. Retries on "try another server" errors up to 3 times. Logs proof errors to `ProofLogItem`. | [T:src/backend_task/contested_names/query_dpns_vote_contenders.rs] |
| Fetch with metadata | `ExtendedEpochInfo::fetch_with_metadata(&sdk, 0, None)` returns `(Option<T>, ResponseMetadata)`. `ResponseMetadata` contains `core_chain_locked_height` used for asset lock proof type decisions (instant vs chain). | [T:src/backend_task/identity/register_identity.rs] |
| Proof error logging | Pattern: `match e { Error::DriveProofError(proof_error, proof_bytes, block_info) => { db.insert_proof_log_item(ProofLogItem { request_type, height, time_ms, proof_bytes, error }); } }`. Applied consistently across all broadcast operations in dash-evo-tool. | [T:src/backend_task/tokens/mint_tokens.rs] |
| Asset lock fallback | When instant lock proof fails ("Instant lock proof signature is invalid"), checks `tx_info.is_chain_locked && height <= metadata.core_chain_locked_height`, then retries with `ChainAssetLockProof { core_chain_locked_height, out_point }`. Applied in identity registration and top-up. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/register_identity.rs] |
| DPNS name query pattern | `DocumentQuery { data_contract: dpns_contract, document_type_name: "domain", where_clauses: [WhereClause { field: "records.identity", operator: Equal, value: Value::Identifier(id) }], limit: 100 }` then `Document::fetch_many(sdk, query)`. Extract `label` and `created_at`/`transferred_at` from documents. | [T:src/backend_task/identity/load_identity.rs] |
